title: Past extraterrestrial presence on the Moon and Mars
summary: Max tells of Past extraterrestrial presence on the Moon and Mars, about an unknown time at The Moon, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I think that the inference to the best explanation of this cumulative data is that there was a past extraterrestrial presence of some kind or another on the moon and on Mars in the solar system more broadly.

plain: A guest named Max, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast about the Moon, says that the best way to explain a growing pile of data is that beings from elsewhere were once present on the Moon and on Mars. He does not say when, only that it was in the past and perhaps across the solar system more broadly. If true, it would mean humans are not the first intelligence to have visited our neighbouring worlds.
